exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Indication for Caesarean section (breech, other, emergency)
cohort: 1,047,644 low-risk women having their first birth in England between 2000 and 2012
finding: Caesarean section had no or only a slight effect on subsequent fertility, with the smallest effect observed for elective Caesarean for breech presentation.
mod_finding: The effect of Caesarean section on subsequent fertility was smallest for elective Caesarean for breech presentation, and this effect was not statistically significant in women younger than 30 years of age.
